notes.text: Case a writes K^\sigma=K, identifies the resulting real points with M_{0,5}^{!}\simeq Sym_2^*(U_{0,3}), and gives real dimension 2 and case 1° (pentagonal).
Case b writes card K^\sigma=3, chooses 0,1,infinity in K^\sigma and writes K={0,1,infinity,lambda,bar lambda}, with lambda in the Poincaré half-plane, real dimension 2, and case 3° (bitétraédral).
Case c writes Card K^\sigma=1 and K^\sigma={P}; the live interlinear formula sets I=K\setminus K^\sigma. The cancelled construction includes 0=sigma 0.

The paragraph says that the four-point system on a complex sphere admits an involutive antiautomorphism, called conjugaison, has real modular dimension 1, and gains one real dimension on adding P, for total dimension 2; it refers to the square-pyramidal case 2°.
The lower chart places the dimensions 2,1,0 over its three graphs and gives component counts 1,10,15 beneath them.
The first chart column gives 12 realizations; the label specifying their kind remains uncertain.
The manuscript writes 10×3×2=60.
The manuscript writes 10×2×6=120.
The manuscript writes 15×2×2=60.
The manuscript writes 5×3×2=30.
The manuscript writes 10×2=20.
The face is manuscript on perforated tractor-feed paper. No coherent front-side typescript or reversed printed text was found to transcribe; sheet_kind is text.
Only muni d’ is crossed out. There is one live un to its right; C’s additional cancelled un is unsupported by the visible ink.
The last factor 2 in 5×3×2 is heavily retraced. The current 2 is clear, but an earlier numeral is not recoverable; none has been invented in the text.
The third graph retains an upright free edge and a separately cancelled oblique branch. Its small baseline gap is preserved. The long arrows lead from the NB lines to the second and third graphs.
The bottom outer loop has its head at the upper end. The central loop-shaped glyph remains doubtful and is not assigned a topological meaning.
The small curve after the first 60 is preserved without supplying a closing parenthesis. The lower two captions remain difficult beneath retouching and cancellation.
The top 3 is retained as author pagination. The separate, lighter bottom-left 35 is retained as foliation in another unnamed hand.
No written date appears on this sheet. No date has been inferred from the paper or arithmetic.
H’s editorial page note and prose drawing synopses are not manuscript prose. The actual drawings are reproduced in TikZ.

Two additional dedicated crops cover the rising first paragraph line and the modulaire line. Earlier adjoining crops contained only contextual fragments of those lines; no decided place was recropped.

Conditional on sigma acting as an involution on the five-element set K, its orbits have sizes1 or2. Thus the fixed-point count is odd and can only be1,3 or5, agreeing with the three cases inherited from the preceding page. This finite-set observation does not prove the asserted moduli identifications or component counts.
